response.text:
No, it isn't too late. Your objection (Einspruch) deadline for the 2025 income tax assessment is Wed 21 Oct 2026 [item:itm_mtehckcf6q7a].

- The assessment letter from Finanzamt Musterstadt is dated Tue 15 Sep 2026. It shows a refund of €312.45 [doc:doc_hynqaw58f550].
- Ordnung's suggested send-by date is Thu 15 Oct 2026 [item:itm_mtehckcf6q7a]. That date leaves time for the post to arrive.
- After the deadline the assessment becomes final and can hardly be changed [item:itm_mtehckcf6q7a].
- You only need to object if you disagree with the assessment. If you do, file the Einspruch with the tax office.

You can use "Draft letter" in Ordnung to prepare the objection. If the case is complicated, you may want advice from a tax adviser.
